title: SDK localization & quickstart cadence: cross-region rollout plan
creator: Aisha Malik
description: Goal: Establish a repeatable cadence for releasing localized SDK builds and companion quickstarts (EN, ES, FR, JA) that aligns with regional GTM windows and minimizes support overhead. Scope: 1) Define triage & prioritization for languages and regions; 2) Create localization QA checklist and CI gating for SDK packaging; 3) Produce localized quickstart templates and short walkthrough videos; 4) Instrument metrics to measure adoption, time-to-first-success, and support tickets; 5) Coordinate release with marketing and docs. Out of scope: translations for full reference docs (handled in separate docs-i18n epic).
acceptance_criteria: Localization cadence defined with milestones and owners for Q2 rollout
CI pipeline gates enforce localized package builds and smoke tests
Minimum localized quickstarts (EN/ES/FR/JA) available in repo and rendered on docs site
Tracking dashboard shows time-to-first-success and initial adoption per locale
Playbook for triaging locale-specific issues and fallback messaging is published
deliverables: CI pipeline changes and a reference GitHub Action for localized SDK builds
4 localized quickstart repos with short 2–3 minute walkthrough videos
Metrics dashboard (DataDog/Grafana) for locale adoption and support volume
Support/playbook doc linking to rollout checklist and escalation paths
risks_and_mitigation: Risk: Translation latency causes slip — Mitigation: use community + vendor hybrid for low-latency pre-releases
Risk: Localized builds introduce regressions — Mitigation: add smoke tests and canary rollout flags per region
Risk: Low adoption in some locales — Mitigation: instrument and hold localized launch promotion with developer advocates
stakeholders: Eng leads: Marco Ortega, Priya Desai
